title: The C20 amino-acid profile mixture model
description:
Empirically derived mixture model with 20 fixed amino-acid frequency profiles, representing different site-specific biochemical constraints. At each site, the likelihood is averaged over these profiles using their mixture weights.

This site-heterogeneous approach effectively mitigates long-branch attraction and systematic biases that often compromise simpler, single-matrix models like LG or WAG.

This version estimates the relative frequencies of the 20 components from the data set under study.

journal.name: Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society B: Biological Sciences
